1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device comprising a processor and memory, wherein the processor executes instructions stored in the memory to compute an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device is configured to identify a correspondence between a specific demonstrated user action and a specific document action by comparing temporal sequences of the demonstrated user actions with sequential steps of the documented procedure.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the identification of the current step comprises determining which step in the documented procedure most closely corresponds to a temporal position in the sequence of demonstrated user actions.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is performed in real-time as the demonstrated user actions are being performed.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, wherein the user interface is configured to dynamically update the highlighting as the alignment is recomputed.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the identification of the next step comprises predicting a subsequent step that the user is likely to perform based on the temporal sequence of demonstrated user actions.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting of the next step is performed in advance of the user performing the next step.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, wherein the user interface is configured to automatically advance to display the next step upon completion of the current step.

9. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, and wherein the similarity metric further comprises a measure of semantic equivalence between user interface elements and documented procedure elements.

10. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment, wherein the alignment device is configured to extract action features from the captured images and compare the extracted action features with action descriptions in the documented procedure.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein the previous user experiences comprise historical data regarding sequences of user actions previously performed by the same user or by other users.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, wherein the document action extractor is configured to parse the documented procedure and identify discrete action steps and their sequential relationships.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device comprising a processor and memory, wherein the processor executes instructions stored in the memory to compute an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device is configured to identify a correspondence between demonstrated user actions and sequential steps of the documented procedure; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, wherein the scrolling device is configured to advance through steps in response to the alignment device identifying completion of a current step.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment, wherein the alignment device is configured to extract action features from the captured images and compare the extracted action features with action descriptions in the documented procedure.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein the previous user experiences comprise historical data regarding sequences of user actions previously performed by the same user or by other users.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the computing step comprises comparing temporal sequences of the demonstrated user actions with sequential steps of the documented procedure to identify correspondences between specific demonstrated user actions and specific document actions.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, wherein the identifying step comprises determining which step in the documented procedure most closely corresponds to a temporal position in the sequence of demonstrated user actions.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is performed in real-time as the demonstrated user actions are being performed.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, wherein the identifying step comprises predicting a subsequent step that the user is likely to perform based on the temporal sequence of demonstrated user actions.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting of the next step is performed in advance of the user performing the next step.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, and wherein the similarity metric further comprises a measure of semantic equivalence between user interface elements and documented procedure elements.

24. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, wherein the computing step comprises extracting action features from the captured images and comparing the extracted action features with action descriptions in the documented procedure.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein the previous user experiences comprise historical data regarding sequences of user actions previously performed by the same user or by other users.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure, wherein the extracting step comprises parsing the documented procedure and identifying discrete action steps and their sequential relationships.

27. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17, wherein the program instructions, when executed, cause the machine to compare temporal sequences of demonstrated user actions with sequential steps of the documented procedure to identify correspondences between specific demonstrated user actions and specific document actions.

28. (Currently amended) A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the computing step comprises comparing temporal sequences of the demonstrated user actions with sequential steps of the documented procedure to identify correspondences between demonstrated user actions and document actions; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment, wherein the highlighting is performed in real-time as the demonstrated user actions are being performed; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment, wherein the scrolling step comprises advancing through steps in response to identifying completion of a current step.

30. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, wherein the computing step comprises extracting action features from the captured images and comparing the extracted action features with action descriptions in the documented procedure.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein the previous user experiences comprise historical data regarding sequences of user actions previously performed by the same user or by other users.

32. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28, wherein the program instructions, when executed, cause the machine to compare temporal sequences of demonstrated user actions with sequential steps of the documented procedure and dynamically update highlighting and scrolling based on the computed alignment.
